data.name: Maelys
data.gender_notes: Maelys is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Maelys is a name with Celtic origins, potentially derived from the Welsh name Meilir, meaning 'merciful'. In the context of Christianity, this name can be seen as a reminder of God's boundless compassion and mercy towards us. The name Maelys carries the meaning “Majestic, radiant one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Maelys usually hope their child will grow to embody majestic, radiant one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Maelys holds spiritual significance as a reminder of the grace and mercy that God extends to us.
data.etymology: Maelys belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Majestic, radiant one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maelys total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
